title: Haggai — Geʽez Löfgren / Ghebre transcription
edition: Oscar Löfgren (ed.), Jona, Nahum, Habakuk, Zephanja, Haggai, Sacharja und Maleachi äthiopisch, unter Zugrundelegung des Oxforder Ms. Huntington 625, nach mehreren Handschriften. Uppsala, 1930, Haggai section pp. 47–53; TAU text prepared by Kefela Ghebre (published with his permission) and proofread by Ran HaCohen (October 2018).
edition_scope: The local reader transcribes the two TAU HTML text pages identified by its index as Haggai chapters 1–2. TAU identifies the underlying historical critical edition and states its bibliographic pages 47–53; the archive has not compared the captured digital chapter pages with that print span or manuscripts. The title-level link to the cited EOTC English list is provisional and does not establish identity with a current official EOTC edition.
transcription_note: Verse bodies are parsed from two captured TAU HTML pages. HTML whitespace is normalized to single spaces; each source-linked BibleGateway label is retained as a separate source_marker. The original pages are stored alongside this reader and checked by SHA-256. No wording was translated, silently emended, renumbered, or aligned to another witness.
editorial_signs_note: Visible Geʽez letters, punctuation, and editorial signs are retained in the extracted text. Image pages and Löfgren's critical apparatus are not bundled. The retained source HTML is the extraction authority for this reader.
chapter_structure_note: The TAU index offers text pages numbered 1–2. The captured pages contain displayed linked numbers 1–14 and 1–23 respectively (37 total). All page links target the matching Haggai chapter. These are observed page labels, not a verified alignment to another numbering system or evidence of print-edition completeness.
